slots.desc: Beginning-of-Winter look: a long cozy red knitted scarf wrapped around the neck, holding a steaming mug of ginger tea with both front hooves, the very first snowflake resting on top of her curly mane, rosy cheeks, gentle happy smile.

Great-detective look: a pink-and-cream houndstooth deerstalker-style cap, short caped coat in plum, holding a big brass magnifying glass up to one eye (the eye looks huge through the lens), a swirl lollipop held like a pipe, clever smug grin.

Queen look: an ornate golden crown with pink gems, a long flowing red velvet cape with white fur trim, a golden scepter topped with a balloon-shaped jewel, golden horseshoes, chin raised in a proud but sweet regal pose.
Princess look: a small sparkly tiara, a fluffy layered pastel-pink ball gown with ruffles and tiny stars, holding a star-tipped magic wand, twirling happily with sparkles.
迷糊史莱姆 (grammar): a wobbly round ink-blot slime, plum-purple with a pink sheen, droopy confused eyes, a little ink drip on top like a hair curl.
书虫 (reading): a chubby green caterpillar-like bookworm peeking out of a hole bitten through a small book, big round glasses.
迷路纸鹤 (translation): a folded origami paper crane with a dizzy spiral in its eyes, pale blue paper, one wing folded the wrong way.
墨水瓶小鬼 (writing): a small round glass inkpot creature with tiny arms, a feather quill stuck in its lid like a hat, splashing a little ink.
回声蝙蝠 (listening): a round fluffy paper bat with giant floppy ears and tiny sound-wave curls around them, lavender color.
字母积木魔像 (vocabulary): a tiny stocky golem made of three stacked wooden toy blocks with blank faces painted as eyes, warm wood and pink.
时态毛线团 (grammar, tenses): a round ball of tangled pink-orange yarn with stubby legs, eyes peeking through the tangles.
橡皮小精灵 (writing): a squishy pink rubber-eraser creature with a little paper-sleeve hat, rubbing crumbs off itself.
便利贴幽灵 (vocabulary): a floating ghost made of a curled yellow sticky note, wavy tail, blank sticky-note body, shy blush.
题目蘑菇 (vocabulary forest): a plump red-capped mushroom with cream spots shaped like question-mark curls, puzzled face, tiny feet.
海螺小蟹 (listening port): a small round hermit crab living in a spiral seashell that looks like an ear, cupping a claw to listen.
时钟甲虫 (grammar, tenses): a round beetle whose shell is an alarm-clock face with no numbers, two clock hands as antennae, sleepy eyes.
小桥怪 (translation bridge): a tiny chubby moss-green troll holding a little wooden plank, cute underbite with one tooth, grumpy-cute.
纸狐 (reading library): a folded origami fox with a tiny bookmark ribbon tail, sly smile, orange and cream paper.
迷雾团 (forgetting fog): a soft round grey-lavender cloud puff with sleepy eyes, wisps trailing, slightly translucent edges.
卷笔刀刺猬 (writing tower): a round hedgehog whose spikes are colored pencil tips and curly pencil shavings, holding a pencil sharpener.
Full health: standing tall and proud, runes glowing brightly, tower upright, confident playful roar pose.
Hurt: wobbling, a few book pages flying loose, some blocks cracked, runes flickering, sweat drop, still determined.
Defeated/broken guard: lying down flat on its belly, tower tilted sideways, little dizzy stars and swirls circling its head, smiling sheepishly, books spilled around.

Head-and-shoulders portrait of the "Babel Beast": a cute majestic guardian beast made of stacked hardcover books and alphabet blocks, a tiny spiral book tower on its head, glowing pink-gold abstract rune glyphs, big friendly eyes.

听力港 Listening Harbor: a cozy paper harbor with a lighthouse whose lamp is a big gramophone horn, small paper boats, sound-wave shaped waves, seagull silhouettes; region colors sea teal and sunrise peach. BACK layer (far background): distant skyline / sky shapes and soft hills of the region, low contrast, misty.

The cover of a magical hardcover study journal "the Book of Reaching the Shore": pink fabric cover, gold foil corner ornaments, a ribbon bookmark, a small balloon-shaped emblem embossed in the center, lying on a wooden desk, viewed from above.
A seamless, tileable texture of thick cream journal paper with subtle grain, faint fibers and very light ruled lines, flat even lighting, viewed straight on, edge-to-edge (no book edges).

A cozy papercraft study camp at daytime: a small round tent-like cottage made of notebook pages, bunting flags, a desk with books, a campfire with paper flames, a signpost, a distant mountain with a castle on top (the goal), sunny warm light. Leave the center-left foreground open for a character to stand.

The same cozy papercraft study camp at night: deep indigo sky with paper stars, warm lamp light glowing from the cottage windows, campfire glow, fireflies made of paper dots, the distant castle with lit windows. Leave the center-left foreground open for a character to stand.
A quiet calm exam hall in muted papercraft: neat rows of wooden desks, a big clock on the wall without numbers, tall windows with soft daylight, low saturation, very calm and focused atmosphere.

Pirate-captain look: a plum tricorne hat with a pink feather, a captain coat with gold buttons, holding a rolled treasure map that looks like an open pop-up book, a spyglass tucked under the arm, adventurous grin (no eyepatch, no skull symbols).
Astronaut look: a rounded pink spacesuit with white panels, a clear bubble helmet with her curly mane floating weightlessly inside, a small star patch, floating pose with a few tiny stars around.
Dragon-rider look: light pink knight-ish riding armor, riding on the back of a small chubby friendly pink baby dragon with tiny wings (dragon is cute, round, and fully visible), both looking heroic.
Knight look: shiny rose-pink plate armor, a round shield decorated with three balloons, a short blunt practice sword raised, brave determined smile, helmet visor pushed up.
Pastry-chef look: a tall white chef hat, a frilly apron with sprinkles, holding a piping bag in one hoof and a big cupcake with swirly frosting in the other, frosting smudge on her nose.

Magical-girl look: a big pink bow, a sparkly transformation outfit with ribbons and a heart brooch, holding a magic wand shaped like a giant red marking pen with a heart tip, ribbons of light swirling around her.

Star-sand astrologer look: a deep indigo star-map cloak with constellation patterns, holding a crystal compass astrolabe like a staff with a glowing crystal, tiny floating star particles, mysterious gentle smile.
Ancient-Chinese top-scholar (状元) look: a red scholar robe with gold trim, a black scholar hat with two flat wings, a big calligraphy brush held proudly, a red ribbon flower on the chest.
Idol singer look: a sparkly stage outfit with a short pleated skirt, a headset microphone, holding a glowing pink light stick, winking with one hoof raised.
Cyber-neon look: glowing visor goggles, a sleek techwear jacket with neon pink and cyan lines, holding a big glowing neon highlighter pen leaving a light trail.
Ninja look: a pink ninja outfit with a scarf tail, holding a scroll, a few soft round paper shuriken stars, crouched in a playful sneaky pose.
Light-Snow look: a knitted pom-pom beanie and mittens, standing next to a small cheerful snowman buddy, gentle snowflakes around.
Heavy-Snow look: a thick hooded winter cloak with fur trim, pulling a small wooden sled, a faint aurora ribbon swirl above her head.
Graduate look: a square graduation cap with tassel, a graduation gown, holding a rolled diploma tube with a ribbon, proud teary happy smile.
Gold-master look: her outline glows with a gold rim light, a row of shiny gold medal stamps pinned across her chest like a sash, a golden laurel hair clip, triumphant pose.
Confetti party burst: she leaps toward the camera from an exploding party cannon, rainbow confetti and balloons everywhere. Costume: her look in the attached mode reference image.
She slams down a giant golden approval stamp onto an open notebook, a shockwave of stars bursting out. Costume: her look in the attached mode reference image.
She stands on a stack of finished project folders as a giant golden checklist stamp crashes down behind her, golden sparks. Costume: her look in the attached mode reference image.
Deep-thought spell: she floats in front of a huge glowing crystal magic circle with geometric runes, eyes closed, crystals orbiting. Costume: her look in the attached mode reference image.
Rainbow warp: she rides a rainbow streak through a starfield tunnel at hyperspeed, rainbow confetti trails. Costume: her look in the attached mode reference image.

Spotlight reveal: dark stage, a single dramatic spotlight on her pointing forward with the magnifying glass, glowing clue threads connecting pinned notes behind her. Costume: Great-detective look: a pink-and-cream houndstooth deerstalker-style cap, short caped coat in plum, holding a big brass magnifying glass up to one eye (the eye looks huge through the lens), a swirl lollipop held like a pipe, clever smug grin.

Treasure rain: on the deck of a paper ship at sunset, she raises the treasure map as gold coins rain from the sky. Costume: Pirate-captain look: a plum tricorne hat with a pink feather, a captain coat with gold buttons, holding a rolled treasure map that looks like an open pop-up book, a spyglass tucked under the arm, adventurous grin (no eyepatch, no skull symbols).

Warp jump: she launches through a swirling galaxy portal, stars stretching into light streaks. Costume: Astronaut look: a rounded pink spacesuit with white panels, a clear bubble helmet with her curly mane floating weightlessly inside, a small star patch, floating pose with a few tiny stars around.

Dragon breath: riding the pink baby dragon in the sky as it breathes a huge beam of warm pink-gold fire. Costume: Dragon-rider look: light pink knight-ish riding armor, riding on the back of a small chubby friendly pink baby dragon with tiny wings (dragon is cute, round, and fully visible), both looking heroic.

Royal entrance: curtains part on a grand stage, a red carpet shockwave rolls toward the camera, she stands under golden spotlights with the scepter raised. Costume: Queen look: an ornate golden crown with pink gems, a long flowing red velvet cape with white fur trim, a golden scepter topped with a balloon-shaped jewel, golden horseshoes, chin raised in a proud but sweet regal pose.

Rose-petal rain: she twirls in a moonlit castle garden as a storm of pink rose petals and sparkles pours down. Costume: Princess look: a small sparkly tiara, a fluffy layered pastel-pink ball gown with ruffles and tiny stars, holding a star-tipped magic wand, twirling happily with sparkles.

Lightning slash: she swings her blunt practice sword leaving a giant crescent of pink lightning across the frame. Costume: Knight look: shiny rose-pink plate armor, a round shield decorated with three balloons, a short blunt practice sword raised, brave determined smile, helmet visor pushed up.

Sprinkle storm: a giant cupcake erupts like a volcano of colorful sugar sprinkles raining over a bakery kitchen. Costume: Pastry-chef look: a tall white chef hat, a frilly apron with sprinkles, holding a piping bag in one hoof and a big cupcake with swirly frosting in the other, frosting smudge on her nose.

Transformation: she spins inside a pillar of ribbons and hearts, a huge heart magic circle beneath her. Costume: Magical-girl look: a big pink bow, a sparkly transformation outfit with ribbons and a heart brooch, holding a magic wand shaped like a giant red marking pen with a heart tip, ribbons of light swirling around her.

Starmap warp: she raises the crystal astrolabe, constellation lines connect across a deep indigo sky and a star-warp tunnel opens. Costume: Star-sand astrologer look: a deep indigo star-map cloak with constellation patterns, holding a crystal compass astrolabe like a staff with a glowing crystal, tiny floating star particles, mysterious gentle smile.

Ink-splash golden list: she swings the giant brush, a massive ink wash explodes across a scroll sky, a red-gold honor banner unfurls (no readable characters). Costume: Ancient-Chinese top-scholar (状元) look: a red scholar robe with gold trim, a black scholar hat with two flat wings, a big calligraphy brush held proudly, a red ribbon flower on the chest.

Concert stage: she sings center stage, a sea of glowing light sticks in the crowd, heart-shaped spotlights. Costume: Idol singer look: a sparkly stage outfit with a short pleated skirt, a headset microphone, holding a glowing pink light stick, winking with one hoof raised.

Neon beam: she fires a beam of neon light from the giant highlighter across a cyber city skyline at night, glitch sparks. Costume: Cyber-neon look: glowing visor goggles, a sleek techwear jacket with neon pink and cyan lines, holding a big glowing neon highlighter pen leaving a light trail.

Smoke dash: she dashes through a cloud of pink smoke leaving afterimages, soft paper shuriken stars flying. Costume: Ninja look: a pink ninja outfit with a scarf tail, holding a scroll, a few soft round paper shuriken stars, crouched in a playful sneaky pose.

First snow: she stands on a quiet winter street holding the ginger tea as the first heavy snowfall of the year begins, warm lantern light, steam rising. Costume: Beginning-of-Winter look: a long cozy red knitted scarf wrapped around the neck, holding a steaming mug of ginger tea with both front hooves, the very first snowflake resting on top of her curly mane, rosy cheeks, gentle happy smile.

Snow shower: she and the snowman buddy throw up their arms as a gentle shower of big snowflakes swirls around them. Costume: Light-Snow look: a knitted pom-pom beanie and mittens, standing next to a small cheerful snowman buddy, gentle snowflakes around.

Aurora warp: sledding down a snowy hill under a huge rippling aurora that bends into a warp tunnel. Costume: Heavy-Snow look: a thick hooded winter cloak with fur trim, pulling a small wooden sled, a faint aurora ribbon swirl above her head.

Graduation: she tosses the graduation cap high into a bright sky, confetti and paper airplanes everywhere. Costume: Graduate look: a square graduation cap with tassel, a graduation gown, holding a rolled diploma tube with a ribbon, proud teary happy smile.

Gold stamp: she slams a giant gold medal stamp down, a golden shockwave lights up a pop-up-book world behind her. Costume: Gold-master look: her outline glows with a gold rim light, a row of shiny gold medal stamps pinned across her chest like a sash, a golden laurel hair clip, triumphant pose.
